name: state-delta-unknown-op-dropped
description: an operation whose `op` RFC 6902 does not define is an unrecognised union member: the element is dropped from the patch with a warning and the rest of the patch applies
kill: make the strip stage treat an unrecognised union member as fatal, or pass it through to the applier

dotnet.intentional: the .NET client says nothing here, and cannot assert the state clause at all: it has no state store and no JSON Patch reducer, so the unrecognised operation is neither dropped nor applied by the client — STATE_DELTA is a recognised event whose delta rides along as opaque JSON, which is why the replay is silent. What this lane still holds .NET to is that the run stays alive and quiet. `warnings` is emptied only to displace the base expectation; `noWarnings` asserts the silence. Aligning .NET is tracked separately.
